info.title: Smart Golf GPS — proposed Laravel contract
info.description: Prepared for aivicventures.com. Proposed routes, NOT deployed or detected. /api/courses returned 404 during read-only inspection on 2026-10-18. Route suffixes and camelCase JSON retain the supplied mobile application contract. x-client-stage identifies pending client integration. This is a specification, not a working backend or feature-completion claim.

bearerAuth.description: Existing Laravel mobile token authentication, such as Sanctum. No client/service secret is embedded in the app.

Point.description: WGS84 degrees. Coordinate objects use lat/lng; GeoJSON coordinates use [longitude, latitude]. No inferred geometry.

MappingReview.description: An authorized mapper declaration, not an app accuracy certification. Reject future dates. Saving/geocoding does not create this declaration. Invalidate on geometry edits.

Polygon.description: CART_PATH is a line requiring >=2 points. All other types require a simple non-self-intersecting ring of >=3 vertices, nonzero area, <=2000 distinct vertices. Rings may be closed. Validate topology and hole extent. Multipolygons/interior rings require a future schema version; never flatten them silently.

id.description: Preserve existing string identifiers during migration; new resources may use UUIDs.

Hazard.description: Legacy mapped point distances are to that point, not an independently established hazard boundary. Carry point is optional and requires actual mapping.

Hole.description: Unknown geometry stays null/empty. Reviewed hole extent <=2.5 km from tee; tee-to-center 10..2000 m; green center must be inside any supplied GREEN polygon. Unique hole numbers. Preserve existing metadata.

id.description: Preserve existing string identifiers during migration; new resources may use UUIDs.

Course.description: Directory anchors are not playing coordinates. No layout generation during create/read/relocate/startup. Legacy simulated courses remain stored and unreviewed. Changes require course-editor authorization. A declared review never promotes simulated data automatically.

HoleScore.description: Score includes penalty strokes. Validate putts + penalty <= score when recorded. Null means unrecorded, not zero. FIR not applicable on par 3. Compute Stableford server-side from explicitly supplied playing handicap; never interpret handicap index as playing handicap.

TrackPoint.description: t is Unix milliseconds; store sample time and server receipt separately. Deduplicate by authenticated round, t and coordinates; exclude simulated samples from learned club distances.

courseId.description: Preserve existing string identifiers during migration; new resources may use UUIDs.

Round.description: Owner is derived from authentication. Snapshot course revision/par/handicap at round start. 9-hole rounds in this client use first nine holes; rank their stroke indices within that nine. Do not alter historical rounds when course mapping changes.

id.description: Preserve existing string identifiers during migration; new resources may use UUIDs.

courseId.description: Preserve existing string identifiers during migration; new resources may use UUIDs.

RoundCreate.description: Create score rows for requested holes. Require enough course holes; scoring may proceed for unreviewed courses, but geometry remains unavailable for playing distances.

RoundUpdate.description: Patch only supplied fields. Preserve unrelated scores. Production updates require If-Match and transactional revision comparison; no blind last-write-wins.

id.description: Preserve existing string identifiers during migration; new resources may use UUIDs.

anyOf.description: Preserve existing string identifiers during migration; new resources may use UUIDs.

Shot.description: Server recomputes surface displacement, including roll; this is not measured carry. Correction preserves original coordinates/audit metadata. Enforce round ownership and <=1 km plausible displacement. Unknown legacy uncertainty stays unknown, not fabricated.

id.description: Preserve existing string identifiers during migration; new resources may use UUIDs.

carry.description: User-supplied carry in YARDS for compatibility; never infer it from GPS total displacement.

Bag.description: id=default is a client display value only. Server must scope the actual row to authenticated user; no global shared default bag.

Settings.description: Per authenticated user. Preserve gpsMode; it was absent from the legacy FastAPI model. Settings do not establish payment entitlements.

Weather.description: No fake zero wind on provider failure. Return available=false with reason when unavailable, stale or unreliable.

Elevation.description: Height datum and model uncertainty must be documented. GPS altitude alone does not establish a calibrated plays-like correction.

resourceId.description: Preserve existing string identifiers during migration; new resources may use UUIDs.

SyncOperation.description: Validate allowlisted fields by resource and scope every operation to the caller. Client time is diagnostic, never the conflict winner. Same operation ID with a different payload is a conflict.

resourceId.description: Preserve existing string identifiers during migration; new resources may use UUIDs.

Entitlement.description: Server verified grant only. Bind signature to account/audience and actual purchase expiry; bounded offline grace, expiry and rollback handling. Trial eligibility/offer terms come from Play configuration, never a universal seven-day promise.

courseId.description: Preserve existing string identifiers during migration; new resources may use UUIDs.

OfflineManifest.description: Only licensed, restricted client tile credentials. No Google/Esri/public OSM bulk mirroring merely because URLs are reachable. Enforce provider area/zoom/storage/expiry terms.

Statistics.description: Use only recorded denominators, exclude unplayed holes; filter by authenticated player.

ClubStatistics.description: Non-simulated total GPS displacement, not carry. Preserve uncertainty/sample count and exclude unusable samples.

id.description: Preserve existing string identifiers during migration; new resources may use UUIDs.

CourseCreate.description: Create a directory/course record. ID and timestamps may be omitted for server assignment. holes may be empty; return blank hole metadata rows without invented coordinates.
